text:
Alice M: Heads-up — saw a cross-region retry spike during last night's cert rollout. Looks like some LB route caches kept an old IP due to DNS TTL mismatch. Starting postmortem follow-ups here.
Ben K: On it. Do we have timeframe and affected regions?
Alice M: Spike 02:03–02:14 UTC. us-west1 -> us-east1 retries mostly. RouteSet-A had stale A records for ~8m after rotation.
Carla P: OK. Suggested immediate action items: 1) add cross-region DNS propagation probes, 2) fastflush rollout caches, 3) add emergency rollback play for TLS/route mismatch, 4) monthly pattern review ticket.
Dinesh R: I'll take #1 (probes + alerting). Plan: synth probes from each region hitting authoritative NS and compare serials/answers. ETA: EOW.
Ben K: I'll do #2 and #3. Fastflush tool to invalidate LB sticky caches + a runbook entry for emergency flush on rollout. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Alice M: @infra-bot can we schedule a canary re-run in us-east to validate the fix post-deploy?
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-2026-03-25-04:00 (us-east1). Will post results.
SRE Oncall: Quick verification steps for anyone testing:
```
dig +short lb.routeset-a.redwood.internal @ns1.us-east1
curl -v --resolve lb.routeset-a.redwood.internal:443:10.2.3.4 https://lb.routeset-a.redwood.internal/health
```
Ben K: Ran the dig against ns2 — returned stale A for ~5m window. Pushing flush now, will re-run probes after flush.
Alice M: Ben, pls add the exact flush command to the runbook. Carla, can you create the ticket for the recurring pattern analysis?
Carla P: Added NET-452 to the board: "cross-region dns-ttl drift & route cache mitigations". Assigned to Platform Patterns. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-452
Dinesh R: For probes I'll prototype a small lambda that queries each authoritative NS, compares SOA serial and A answers, and emits a metric if mismatch > 30s. Will post PR link when ready.
Ben K: Also adding a pre- and post-deploy check that queries all regional resolvers and fails deployment if divergence > threshold. Putting it in CI smoke.
Alice M: Owners/timelines recap:
- Dinesh R: cross-region DNS probes & alerting — EOW
- Ben K: rollout fastflush tool + runbook + CI pre-check — tomorrow AM
- Carla P: ticket + pattern analysis — done (NET-452)
- SRE Oncall: monitor canary + validate cross-region probes after deploy — ongoing
Ben K: Pushed runbook snippet and commands. Example flush command added: `./tools/route-flush --routeset routeset-a --force`
SRE Oncall: Dashboard updated with a short-lived panel for TTL mismatch rate: https://grafana.redwood/d/ttl-mismatch. Will let this run for 72h.
Alice M: We'll reconvene here in 48h to close or add follow-ups. If anything regresses ping @SRE Oncall and escalate to Platform. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Ben K: Thanks — I'll post a short postmortem update once flush and canary are clean.
Carla P: Adding a recurring calendar reminder for pattern reviews every 6 weeks.
Dinesh R: FYI test probe output (example):
```
region: us-west1, ns: ns1.us-west1 -> A: 10.10.1.4, soa: 2026032502
region: us-east1, ns: ns1.us-east1 -> A: 10.10.2.4, soa: 2026032501
mismatch_detected: true
```
Alice M: Great. Appreciate the quick ownership. Closing initial follow-ups; we'll keep this thread as the action tracker.
